scope: Consolidated frontend dependency refresh and supported build toolchain

credits.approach: Resolve one current lockfile instead of replaying overlapping upstream lock patches. Package maintainers supplied the upstream security fixes.

Fix advisories without forcing an incompatible React upgrade; existing imports and router API are retained
Remove vulnerable utility dependency through its owning direct package; mergeTypeDefs public API still generates unchanged schema and Relay artifacts

lint_tool_pins.reason: Retain original working lint diagnostics while refreshing their dependency security patches. Newer combinations introduce StyleX import false positives or import-plugin API failures. All existing rules and zero-warning requirement remain enabled.

audit.source: Yarn Classic registry audit, measured on 2026-11-03; counts identify reported dependency paths, not confirmed reachable exploits
audit.grouping: Explicit --groups dependencies distinguishes production from full graph; Yarn Classic dev:false flags are not used for classification

remaining.title: minimatch has potential denial of service via globparts amplification
remaining.disposition: Deferred lint-toolchain migration. Affected packages appear only in development audit; no production advisory. Do not force minimatch 11 into callers pinned to majors 3 and 9. Audit reports this risk; no blanket exception or suppression is configured.

build.includes: TypeScript typecheck and Vite production build

browser_smoke.server: Temporary local-only production static server and synthetic GraphQL/video fixture server
browser_smoke.observed: Unknown path renders Page not found and its observed homepage link navigates to root. A valid synthetic defaultVideo matching the non-null Video schema, bundled bedroom MP4/poster and synthetic startSession response then initialize the natural video editor. Visual inspection confirms the bedroom video frame, generated filmstrip, Play control, Change video button and Object 1. This validates frontend startup/worker decoding and routing with synthetic services; no real backend/model acceptance is claimed.
preexisting_warnings: Inter-VariableFont.ttf reference does not match shipped font filename; browser font decode warnings
browser_smoke.cleanup: Temporary Chrome sessions, Vite preview server and valid fixture servers stopped
browser_smoke.discarded_probe: An initial defaultVideo:null response violated the actual defaultVideo:Video! schema and caused an editor error; discarded as an invalid fixture, then replaced by the valid video above.
